This is a development note, not a participant guide, curriculum, or tested hosting manual. No finished downloadable program resources are available in alpha v0.1.

::: {.table-scroll role="region" aria-label="Program resource development plan" tabindex="0"}

| Audience | Planned materials | What must happen first |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Teenagers | Idea prompts, project planning worksheets, reflection materials | Review original TSP materials; seek youth feedback on clarity and access |
| Adult facilitators | Preparation guidance, discussion prompts, support and reflection notes | Review original materials and local safeguarding responsibilities |
| Host communities | Adaptable gathering guidance, resource mapping, follow-through planning | Review local implementation needs and access barriers |
| All contributors | Feedback prompts, adaptation notes, revision history | Establish a privacy-conscious feedback route and review process |

:::


Future public resources will have a description, audience, status, version date, and clear limitations. Downloadable materials will be linked only when they exist and are approved for publication.

Local contributions can help improve future versions. [Read how community learning will work](../feedback.qmd).
